list.title: Workshops
list.maxDiscountHint: The most one guest can get off the price with the promotions that run today, following the rules for combining them.

form.contentHint: Write the text per language. The default language is required; other enabled languages are recommended.
form.title: Title
form.notesHint: For example what to wear or bring.
form.missingTitle: Some enabled languages are missing translations
form.missingHint: Guests who use these languages will see the default language instead.
form.currencyHint: The currency follows the shop settings.
form.priceChangeNote: A new price only applies to new bookings. Existing bookings keep their price.
form.imagesHint: One cover image and up to {max} gallery images.
form.uploaderStub: Image upload is not available yet. Paste image URLs below for now.
form.hasBookings: This workshop has {count, plural, one {# booking} other {# bookings}} and cannot be deleted. Archive it instead.
form.noDelete: Workshops cannot be deleted once they have bookings. Archive them instead.
form.savedSim: Saved (demo mode: changes are not persisted).
form.archiveHint: Archived workshops are hidden from the landing page and cannot receive new bookings. Existing bookings are kept.

errors.titleRequired: A title in the default language is required.
errors.priceInvalid: Enter a price of zero or more.
errors.durationRange: Duration must be a whole number between 15 and 600 minutes.
errors.capacityRange: Capacity must be a whole number between 1 and 50.
errors.maxPerBookingRange: Must be at least 1 and not more than the capacity.
errors.galleryMax: You can add up to 6 gallery images.
errors.timesRequired: Add at least one start time.
errors.toBeforeFrom: The end date cannot be before the start date.
errors.duplicateSession: A session for this workshop already exists at that time.
errors.capacityBelowReserved: Capacity cannot be lower than the {reserved} seats already reserved.

rules.title: Schedule rules
rules.hint: Rules generate sessions for the next 60 days. Start times are in {tz}.
rules.empty: No schedule rules yet. Add a rule or create one-off sessions.
rules.generateNote: Saving or removing a rule regenerates future sessions that have no bookings. Sessions that already have bookings are never changed or deleted.
rules.changedSim: Rule changed (demo mode: sessions are not regenerated).
rules.timesHint: Start times use the shop timezone ({tz}).
rules.toHint: Optional. Leave empty for no end date.
rules.capacityOverrideHint: Optional. Replaces the workshop default for these sessions.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.cancelHint: All confirmed bookings will be cancelled with this reason and each guest will be emailed in their language.
sessions.cancelImpact: {count, plural, =0 {No confirmed bookings will be cancelled.} one {# confirmed booking ({guests} guests) will be cancelled.} other {# confirmed bookings ({guests} guests) will be cancelled.}}
sessions.capacityHint: {reserved} seats are already reserved. Capacity cannot go below that.
